facts.text: The INSPIRE Maine Scholarship promise program covers 100% of tuition and mandatory fees for up to 30 credits per year over four years for eligible Maine residents.

sources.title: Promise Programs - Student Financial Services - University of Maine

facts.text: Through the Flagship Match Commitment, eligible out-of-state students pay tuition equivalent to the in-state rate at their home state's flagship university.

sources.title: Flagship Match - Undergraduate Admissions - The University of Maine
